project.name: BrixUp
project.description: BrixUp is the first tokenized real estate marketplace where investors, builders, and dealmakers unite under smart contracts to develop property and share the profits. The $BRIX token powers the entire platform — used for investments, staking rewards, contractor payments, and governance.

platform_treasury.purpose: Platform operations, ecosystem growth, deal funding

community_rewards.purpose: Staking rewards (12.5% APY), referral bonuses, community incentives

team_advisors.purpose: 6-month cliff, 24-month linear vesting via BRIXVesting contract

liquidity_pool.purpose: Uniswap v3 BRIX/USDC pool on Base

features.anti_bot: 10M token max transfer limit for first 24 hours post-launch
features.staking: 12.5% APY via BRIXStaking contract, no lock period
features.vesting: Team tokens locked with 6-month cliff + 24-month linear vesting, revocable
features.burn: Any holder can burn their tokens
features.pausable: Owner can pause all transfers in emergencies

BRIX.description: ERC-20 token with 0.5% transfer fee, anti-bot protection, pausable

BRIXStaking.description: Synthetix-style staking pool, 12.5% APY, no lock period

BRIXVesting.description: Linear vesting for Team & Advisors, 6-month cliff, 24-month duration

requirements: Active trading on at least one supported exchange or DEX
Working block explorer with verified contract
Trading on a supported DEX (Uniswap v3 on Base qualifies)
